title: Relationship Pricing Statement — Farm Real Estate Loans and the Class H Preferred Stock Dividend, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A member who borrows on farm real estate with the association earns a relationship premium on the quarterly dividend of their Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock.

## Statement

The dividend relationship premium rests on the member's farm real estate borrowing with the association, read from the member's Farm Real Estate Loans records — the loan's status and its principal balance:

| Member's Farm Real Estate Loans | Dividend relationship premium |
|---|---|
| An active farm real estate loan whose principal balance is 250000 or more | 0.15 percentage point |
| An active farm real estate loan whose principal balance is below 250000 | 0.05 percentage point |
| No active farm real estate loan | None |

The premium is added, in percentage points, to the annual rate at which the quarterly dividend is figured, the sum being one annual rate applied once; the premium never acts on another part of the rate.

## Edges (hypothetical members)

| Farm real estate loan on the record | Premium |
|---|---|
| Active, principal balance USD 250,000.00 | 0.15 — exactly 250000 earns the higher premium |
| Active, principal balance USD 249,999.99 | 0.05 |
| Paid off and closed | None — no active farm real estate loan |
| No farm real estate loan with the association | None |

Only a loan in active status counts. The principal balance is the outstanding principal shown on the farm real estate loan.
